visualCharacteristics.purpose: Contact / registration form with inputs, choice groups and submit
visualCharacteristics.layout: Stacked full-width fields with floating labels, radio groups, consent text, submit bottom right; 8 of 12 columns centred from 960px
notable: Short radio lists sit in one row
POSTs JSON to a configured action, otherwise shows the confirmation only

contentPattern.structure: One row per field: Label | Type (text, email, tel, number, date, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, plaintext, submit) | Options (comma-separated) | Required; config rows action, thank-you, error

usage: Use for contact, order and registration forms.
reuseGuidance: Fits forms up to ~20 fields posting to one endpoint; multi-step or conditional forms need a dedicated form solution.
